current: No cross-region Fabric or quorum exists (execution_nodes = {} everywhere, no multi-region deployment). The adjacent centre-cell wire attempts no quorum and never waits indefinitely: an unreachable peer's delta is retried along a bounded ladder and then dead-lettered, and a circuit breaker makes later messages cost zero attempts. It does wait, though: the ladder runs on the cell's work-loop thread (the dead-letter test's own comment says so) and qip-edge-node runs the centre exchange synchronously before each pass (FABRIC-003, INCORRECT after verification), so a remote outage raises local pass latency by up to one ladder before the breaker opens. Cell::is_region_dark lets a cell proceed without a dark region.

gap: No cross-region deployment or Fabric mirror exists to prove never attempts a synchronous quorum. The adjacent wire proves bounded waiting, not independence from remote latency: the requirement's check (local produce-ack latency unchanged under added cross-region latency) would fail on today's edge node until ADR 0100 §6 moves the exchange off the decision thread.
